entities.summary: Hector Calma is a Filipino former professional basketball player. At 5 feet and 8 inches, he played at the point guard position and was most notably associated with the San Miguel Beer team of the Philippine Basketball Association (PBA). Hector Calma was a athletes & competitors from Santa Ana (b. 1960-03-02, Santa Ana). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
